changes.text: Here measured_structural_state requires experimental structural data from the actual scoped preparation. An experimentally determined and refined crystallographic or cryo-EM model, a fitted ligand identity and a model-derived contact remain interpretations constrained by those data; retain the actual density, resolution, identity and refinement limits available in the source. A wholly predicted, homology-modeled, docked or simulated state without corresponding experimental structural data is outside this measured operand, even if deposited. The prediction_not_measurement qualification does not supply experimental origin, change applicability or create observed extent. Record such a prediction separately with its actual origin and appropriate non-direct target attribution rather than treating its coordinates as a measured state.
changes.enum_change: none required; the qualification may describe an inferred functional claim, but it cannot establish measured structural origin

changes.text: Preserve whether the input model was experimentally constrained/refined or purely predicted; deposition and a computable coordinate are not experimental measurements. A distance/contact calculation from an experimentally refined model is a dependent derived result under that model's uncertainty. A calculation from purely predicted coordinates remains prediction-derived and cannot gain direct observed_extent by producing numerical geometry. Keep model-dependent contact or ligand interpretations separate from observed affinity, reaction, net transport and energetic necessity.

State the directly constrained structural proposition separately from any functional interpretation. Use feature_structure for an observed tunnel, architecture or contact arrangement and binds only for the source-supported bounded association/occupancy with its actual identity uncertainty. Structural compatibility alone is not a measured transports, catalyzes, requires, partner_dependence or uses event. For those functional hypotheses, retain the explicit structural-to-function assumptions and the precise compatibility or incompatibility established; an assertion of measured occurrence that lacks the corresponding functional observation does_not_discriminate. In LetB, tunnel/contact compatibility leaves net transport, direction and exact physiological lipid identity unresolved. In FrsA, density modeled as hexanoate with unknown ligand identity does not establish specific hexanoate binding.
changes.numerical_or_schema_change: none; exact relationship wording only, no new acceptance gate or score

changes.new_text: experimentally constrained/refined versus purely predicted origin (deposition is a separate provenance fact)
